control_failures.control_label: segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - permit to work records incomplete for P-3222

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PROXIMITY_DETECTION_AND_SEGREGATION: the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment on P-3222, M-3222 and PT-3222 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling traffic on operating areas, specifically parking, chocking and restraining equipment. P-3222 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment had degraded below its design intent. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 19 May 2018 a planned critical control verification of P-3222, M-3222 and PT-3222 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment not effective.
